petunjuk: Answer based on your everyday life.
There are no right or wrong answers.
Your answers are only stored on this phone.
tentang: This test measures five sides of personality according to the Big Five model: {sisi}. Each side has six facets, giving 30 facets from {jumlah} statements.

For each statement you choose how accurately it describes you, from "Very inaccurate" (1) to "Very accurate" (5). Some statements are scored in reverse. The average answer for each side is then converted to a number from 0 to 100.

Your result character (for example The Explorer) comes from the side whose score is furthest from 50. The second furthest side becomes an extra trait. If every score is in the middle range, your character is The All-Rounder.
privasi: Your answers and results are stored only on this phone. The app has no accounts, no server, and never sends your answers anywhere.
You can delete all answers at any time in Settings, then Delete answers. Uninstalling the app also deletes everything.

This app shows ads from Google AdMob. To show ads, Google may use your device's advertising ID and technical data such as phone model and approximate location from your IP address. This data is governed by Google's privacy policy and is not stored by us. You can manage or reset your advertising ID in your phone's Settings, under Google, then Ads.
The Story card is created on this phone and is only sent to the app you choose when sharing.
penafian: This test is meant for self-discovery. The results are not a psychological or medical diagnosis and do not replace an assessment by a psychologist or psychiatrist.
The scores are not a comparison with other people (they are not percentiles), and this app has not been through scientific validation of its own.
Do not use these results to make important decisions about other people, such as hiring or rejecting job applicants, or judging a partner.
If you are feeling overwhelmed, extremely anxious, or have thoughts of hurting yourself, please talk to someone you trust or a mental health professional, or call your local emergency number.
sumberIlmiah: This test uses the IPIP-NEO-120: 120 public-domain statements developed and tested by John A. Johnson to measure the five sides of personality and their 30 facets.

The statements come from the International Personality Item Pool (IPIP), an open collection of personality test items started by Lewis R. Goldberg. The five sides and 30 facets follow the Five-Factor Model of Paul T. Costa and Robert R. McCrae.
This app is not affiliated with these researchers.

tes.judul: Five sides of your personality, built from 120 answers.
tes.tanya: How accurately does this describe you?
caraBaca: The numbers 0 to 100 show where you sit on the answer scale: 0 means all your answers were at the very low end, 100 at the very high end. They are not percentiles, so 70 doesn't mean you scored higher than 70% of people.
Below 38 counts as low, above 62 as high, and anything in between as average. No score is better than another. Every position has its own strengths and weak spots.
This result reflects tendencies in your own answers. It is not a diagnosis. For important decisions, talk to a psychologist.
tes.sumber: Test items: IPIP-NEO-120 by John A. Johnson (2014), from the International Personality Item Pool, in the public domain.

uraian.tinggi: You're drawn to ideas, art, and new experiences. You get bored with the same old thing and like trying approaches nobody has used before.
uraian.sedang: You're open to new things when the benefit is clear, but you're still comfortable with what's proven.
uraian.rendah: You prefer things that are real, practical, and tested. Very abstract ideas rarely appeal to you.

uraian.tinggi: You're organized, neat, and you finish what you start. People can count on your word.
uraian.sedang: You can be organized when needed, but you're not rigid. Some things you plan, some you let flow.
uraian.rendah: You're spontaneous and flexible. Plans, tidiness, and routine tasks don't come naturally, so deadlines and reminders from outside help a lot.

uraian.tinggi: You get energy from people and lively places. You easily start conversations and love joining in.
uraian.sedang: You enjoy company but also need time alone. It depends on the mood and the people.
uraian.rendah: You recharge by being alone. You prefer small, deep conversations to big crowds.

uraian.tinggi: You're warm, trusting, and tend to give in to keep relationships smooth.
uraian.sedang: You cooperate well, but you'll still disagree when it matters.
uraian.rendah: You're blunt and skeptical. You care more about results and the truth than about sparing feelings.

uraian.tinggi: You worry easily, overthink, or get swept up in your moods. Pressure feels heavier for you than for most people.
uraian.sedang: Your emotions rise and fall within a normal range. Big pressure still gets to you, but you usually bounce back.
uraian.rendah: You're calm and hard to shake. Problems rarely stay on your mind for long.
